summary: UGI Corp via subsidiary UGI International priced €300M 5.000% senior notes due 2031 in a private offering exempt from registration. Proceeds will repay revolving credit facility borrowings, term loan borrowings, and intercompany loans, with remainder for general corporate purposes. Closing expected May 21, 2026, subject to customary conditions. No change of control, premium, or special-situation catalyst. Routine debt refinancing via a subsidiary; no acquisition, tender, or strategic event.
